notes.title: [Patch note:Ver1.12] Game capacity reduction and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Reduced game capacity.
[*] Fixed ship is uncontrollable tutorial after skipping tutorial in some condition. 
[*] Removed anti-break of 3rd stage boss in unlimited mode.
[*] Fixed stage 5 mid-boss keeps on attacking after it is defeted in some condition.
[/list]

notes.title: [Patchnote:Ver1.10] Total Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29519878/dd1d941545d66ca38818031381edd7bc164b0bff.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Fixed game freeze when more than 3 game devices are connected.
[*]Totally renewed scoreboard.
[*]Fixed minor bug in select menu.
[*]Added predictive lines for some enemies' laser attack.
[*]Modified predictive lines broader.
[*]Fixed score balances.
[*]Score window(in the upper left of the screen) color varies by difficulty.
[*]Added special menu in game start after finish the game.
[*]Enabled replay for unlimited mode.
[*]Disabled stage bosses' suicide bullet in expert difficulty. 
[*]Modified bullet eliminate timing after defeating mid-bosses.
[*]Modified red (enemies') bullet color clearer.
